scenarios.title: 机场值机与安检
scenarios.description: 办理登机牌、托运行李、通过安检的常用表达。

lines.en: Good morning. May I see your passport and booking reference, please?
lines.zh: 早上好。可以看一下您的护照和订座编号吗？
lines.tip: booking reference 也可说 confirmation number。

lines.en: Here you are. I have one bag to check in.
lines.zh: 给您。我有一件行李要托运。
lines.tip: check in a bag = 托运行李。

lines.en: Please put your suitcase on the belt. Any carry-on luggage?
lines.zh: 请把行李箱放到传送带上。有随身行李吗？
lines.tip: belt 指行李传送带；carry-on = 随身行李。

lines.en: Just this backpack. Is the flight on time?
lines.zh: 只有这个双肩包。航班准点吗？
lines.tip: on time 准点；delayed 延误。

lines.en: Yes. Boarding starts at gate B12 at ten forty. Have a nice trip.
lines.zh: 准点。10:40 在 B12 登机口开始登机。旅途愉快。

lines.en: Thank you. Where is the security check?
lines.zh: 谢谢。安检怎么走？

lines.en: Go straight and turn left after the shops.
lines.zh: 直走，过了商店左转。
lines.tip: 指路常用：go straight, turn left/right。

lines.en: Got it. Thanks for your help.
lines.zh: 明白了，谢谢您的帮助。
lines.tip: Got it = 明白了，口语很常用。

scenarios.title: 航班延误与改签
scenarios.description: 询问延误原因、改签与餐食补偿。

lines.en: Excuse me, the board says my flight to Shanghai is delayed. Do you know why?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，显示屏说我去上海的航班延误了。请问是什么原因？

lines.en: There is heavy rain over the route. The new departure time is four thirty.
lines.zh: 航路上有大雨。新的起飞时间是 4:30。
lines.tip: departure / arrival 是机场核心词。

lines.en: That is more than three hours. Can I rebook an earlier connection?
lines.zh: 超过三小时了。我能改签更早的衔接航班吗？
lines.tip: rebook = 改签；connection = 衔接航班。

lines.en: I am afraid that flight is full. I can put you on the seven o'clock service instead.
lines.zh: 恐怕那班已经满了。我可以帮您改到七点那班。
lines.tip: put you on a flight = 帮您安排航班。

lines.en: That works. Will the airline provide a meal voucher?
lines.zh: 可以。航空公司会提供餐券吗？
lines.tip: meal voucher = 餐券；compensation = 赔偿。

lines.en: Yes, for delays over three hours. Please collect it at the transfer desk.
lines.zh: 会的，延误超过三小时可以领取。请到中转柜台领取。

lines.en: Could you also check whether my suitcase is still on the original plane?
lines.zh: 能帮我也确认一下行李是否还在原航班上吗？

lines.en: It will be transferred automatically. Here is your new boarding pass.
lines.zh: 行李会自动转运。这是您的新登机牌。

scenarios.title: 餐厅点餐
scenarios.description: 入座、点菜、询问忌口与结账。

lines.en: Good evening. A table for two?
lines.zh: 晚上好。两位吗？
lines.tip: A table for two, please. 是最常用开场。

lines.en: Yes, please. Could we sit by the window?
lines.zh: 是的。可以坐靠窗的位置吗？

lines.en: Of course. Here is the menu. Are you ready to order?
lines.zh: 当然。这是菜单。现在点餐吗？
lines.tip: ready to order = 可以点餐了。

lines.en: We would like the chicken curry and a tomato salad, please.
lines.zh: 我们想要咖喱鸡和一份番茄沙拉。
lines.tip: We would like... 比 We want... 更礼貌。

lines.en: Anything to drink? We have fresh juice and green tea.
lines.zh: 喝点什么？我们有鲜榨果汁和绿茶。
lines.tip: Anything to drink? 餐厅高频问句。

lines.en: Two glasses of orange juice, please. Is the curry very spicy?
lines.zh: 两杯橙汁，谢谢。咖喱很辣吗？

lines.en: It is mildly spicy. I can ask the kitchen to make it milder.
lines.zh: 微辣。我可以请厨房做得更淡一些。

lines.en: That would be great. Could we have the bill after the meal?
lines.zh: 那太好了。饭后可以结账吗？

scenarios.title: 餐厅反馈与退换
scenarios.description: 礼貌反馈上菜错误或口味问题。

lines.en: Sorry to bother you, but I ordered the grilled fish, not the fried chicken.
lines.zh: 不好意思打扰一下，我点的是烤鱼，不是炸鸡。
lines.tip: Sorry to bother you... 先缓和语气再指出问题。

lines.en: I am terribly sorry for the mix-up. I will take this back right away.
lines.zh: 非常抱歉弄混了。我马上撤走这道菜。
lines.tip: mix-up = 搞混；terribly sorry 语气更重。

lines.en: Thank you. Also, the soup is a little cold. Could you heat it up?
lines.zh: 谢谢。另外汤有点凉，能加热一下吗？

lines.en: Of course. Would you like a complimentary dessert while you wait?
lines.zh: 当然。等待期间需要一份免费甜点吗？

lines.en: That is very kind. How long will the fish take?
lines.zh: 太客气了。烤鱼大概要多久？
lines.tip: How long will it take? 时间类必会句。

lines.en: About ten minutes. I will bring it as soon as it is ready.
lines.zh: 大约十分钟。一做好我就送来。

lines.en: Perfect. We appreciate your quick response.
lines.zh: 很好。谢谢你们这么快处理。
lines.tip: appreciate 比 thank 更正式一点。

scenarios.title: 酒店入住
scenarios.description: 预订确认、登记入住、询问设施。

lines.en: Hello, I have a reservation under the name Li.
lines.zh: 你好，我用 Li 这个名字订了房。
lines.tip: under the name... = 以…名义预订。

lines.en: Welcome. May I see your ID, please? A double room for three nights?
lines.zh: 欢迎。可以看一下证件吗？大床房住三晚？
lines.tip: double room 大床房；twin room 两张单人床。

lines.en: Yes. Does the room include breakfast?
lines.zh: 是的。房间含早餐吗？

lines.en: Yes, from seven to ten on the second floor. Here is your key card.
lines.zh: 含的，早上七点到十点在二楼。这是您的房卡。

lines.en: Is there a gym in the hotel? And what time is check-out?
lines.zh: 酒店有健身房吗？退房时间是几点？

lines.en: The gym is on the top floor. Check-out is at noon.
lines.zh: 健身房在顶层。退房时间是中午十二点。

lines.en: Great. Could I get a wake-up call at six thirty tomorrow?
lines.zh: 好的。明天六点半能叫醒我吗？

lines.en: Certainly. Enjoy your stay with us.
lines.zh: 当然。祝您入住愉快。
lines.tip: Enjoy your stay! 酒店标准结束语。

scenarios.title: 酒店设施问题
scenarios.description: 房间设施故障、换房与投诉处理。

lines.en: Front desk? This is room 806. The air conditioner is not working.
lines.zh: 前台吗？这里是 806 房。空调坏了。
lines.tip: This is room 806. 电话里表明房间号。

lines.en: I am sorry to hear that. I will send maintenance up in fifteen minutes.
lines.zh: 很抱歉。我十五分钟内安排维修人员上去。

lines.en: Thank you. Also, the Wi-Fi keeps dropping in the room.
lines.zh: 谢谢。另外房间 Wi-Fi 经常掉线。

lines.en: Would you prefer a room closer to the router? We have one available.
lines.zh: 您愿意换到离路由器更近的房间吗？现在有一间空房。

lines.en: That sounds good, as long as it is on a high floor and quiet.
lines.zh: 那不错，只要楼层高一些、安静就可以。

lines.en: It is room 1204. We can move your luggage for you.
lines.zh: 是 1204 房。我们可以帮您搬行李。
lines.tip: move your luggage = 搬运行李。

lines.en: I appreciate it. Should I pack my things now?
lines.zh: 谢谢。我现在需要收拾东西吗？

lines.en: Yes, please. The bellman will knock in ten minutes.
lines.zh: 麻烦您。行李员十分钟后敲门。

scenarios.title: 购物退换货
scenarios.description: 出示小票、说明问题、协商退款或换货。

lines.en: Hi, I bought this sweater yesterday, but the sleeve is damaged.
lines.zh: 你好，我昨天买了这件毛衣，但是袖子有破损。
lines.tip: damaged = 破损的；defective 有瑕疵的。

lines.en: I am sorry about that. Do you have the receipt with you?
lines.zh: 很抱歉。您带小票了吗？

lines.en: Yes, here it is. Can I exchange it for the same size?
lines.zh: 带了，给你。可以换同款同码吗？
lines.tip: exchange A for B = 用 A 换 B。

lines.en: Let me check stock. We have the same item in medium.
lines.zh: 我查一下库存。同款有中码。
lines.tip: in stock 有货；out of stock 缺货。

lines.en: Perfect. If not, I would like a full refund.
lines.zh: 太好了。如果没有的话，我希望全额退款。

lines.en: We can process the exchange now. Would you like to try it on?
lines.zh: 现在就可以办理换货。您要试穿一下吗？

lines.en: Yes, please. Where is the fitting room?
lines.zh: 好的。试衣间在哪里？

lines.en: Behind you, on the left. Take your time.
lines.zh: 在您身后左边。慢慢试。

scenarios.title: 看医生
scenarios.description: 描述症状、询问用药与休息建议。

lines.en: What seems to be the problem today?
lines.zh: 今天哪里不舒服？

lines.en: I have had a sore throat and a dry cough for three days.
lines.zh: 我嗓子疼、干咳已经三天了。
lines.tip: sore throat 嗓子疼；dry cough 干咳。

lines.en: Any fever or shortness of breath?
lines.zh: 有发烧或呼吸急促吗？
lines.tip: shortness of breath = 呼吸急促。

lines.en: A mild fever last night, around thirty-eight degrees.
lines.zh: 昨晚有点低烧，大概 38 度。
lines.tip: mild fever 低烧；high fever 高烧。

lines.en: Please open your mouth. The throat looks inflamed, but the lungs are clear.
lines.zh: 请张开嘴。咽部有些发炎，但肺部清晰。

lines.en: Do I need antibiotics?
lines.zh: 我需要用抗生素吗？

lines.en: Not yet. Rest, drink warm fluids, and take this lozenge twice a day.
lines.zh: 暂时不用。多休息、喝温水，这个含片一天两次。

lines.en: If it gets worse, should I come back?
lines.zh: 如果加重了，需要再来吗？
lines.tip: get worse 加重；get better 好转。

scenarios.title: 职场：开会与汇报
scenarios.description: 会议开场、进度汇报、征求反馈。

lines.en: Let's get started. Today we will review the project timeline.
lines.zh: 我们开始吧。今天复盘项目时间线。
lines.tip: Let's get started. 会议常用开场。

lines.en: Sure. The design phase is finished, and testing starts next Monday.
lines.zh: 好的。设计阶段已完成，测试下周一启动。
lines.tip: phase 阶段；kick off 启动。

lines.en: Any risks we should flag before the launch?
lines.zh: 上线前有哪些风险需要标注？
lines.tip: flag a risk = 标记/提出风险。

lines.en: Mainly the server capacity. We may need a temporary upgrade during peak hours.
lines.zh: 主要是服务器容量。高峰期可能需要临时扩容。
lines.tip: capacity 容量；peak hours 高峰时段。

lines.en: Could you send a short summary after the meeting?
lines.zh: 会后能发一份简短纪要吗？
lines.tip: summary / minutes 都可表示纪要。

lines.en: Of course. I will share it before five this afternoon.
lines.zh: 当然。我下午五点前发出。

lines.en: Great. Any other comments from the team?
lines.zh: 很好。团队还有其它意见吗？

lines.en: I suggest we keep a one-hour buffer before the deadline.
lines.zh: 我建议截止前预留一小时缓冲。

scenarios.title: 职场：邮件确认与电话沟通
scenarios.description: 确认邮件内容、改约时间、礼貌催办。

lines.en: Hi Anna, I am calling to confirm the details in my email about Friday's workshop.
lines.zh: 你好 Anna，我来电确认邮件里周五工作坊的细节。
lines.tip: confirm 确认；workshop 工作坊/研讨。

lines.en: Thanks. I saw it. Could we move the session to two o'clock?
lines.zh: 谢谢。我看到了。能改到两点开始吗？

lines.en: Two works for me. Shall I update the calendar invite?
lines.zh: 两点可以。需要我更新日历邀请吗？

lines.en: Yes, please. Also attach the latest slide deck.
lines.zh: 麻烦了。也请附上最新幻灯片。

lines.en: Will do. Have you had a chance to review the budget draft?
lines.zh: 好的。预算草稿您抽空看了吗？
lines.tip: Have you had a chance to... 委婉催办。

lines.en: I am looking at it now. I will send comments by noon.
lines.zh: 我正在看。中午前会发意见。

lines.en: Perfect. If anything is unclear, feel free to call me.
lines.zh: 太好了。若有不清楚的，随时打给我。
lines.tip: feel free to... 随时可以。

scenarios.title: 家庭：晚餐闲聊
scenarios.description: 询问一天过得如何、分享家常话题。

lines.en: How was your day, Mom?
lines.zh: 妈妈，今天过得怎么样？
lines.tip: How was your day? 家庭高频问句。

lines.en: Busy but fine. Did you finish your homework?
lines.zh: 忙但还好。作业写完了吗？
lines.tip: homework 不可数，不说 a homework。

lines.en: Almost. I need help with two maths problems.
lines.zh: 差不多了。有两道数学题想请教。
lines.tip: need help with... 在某方面需要帮助。

lines.en: After dinner, then. Wash your hands first.
lines.zh: 那就晚饭后。先去洗手。
lines.tip: After dinner, then. 省略句很自然。

lines.en: Okay. What are we having tonight?
lines.zh: 好的。今晚吃什么？
lines.tip: What are we having? 比 What do we eat? 更口语。

lines.en: Tomato eggs and some green vegetables. Dad will be home late.
lines.zh: 番茄炒蛋和青菜。爸爸会晚点回。

lines.en: Can we save some food for him?
lines.zh: 能给他留点菜吗？

scenarios.title: 家庭：周末计划
scenarios.description: 商量周末安排、分工与出行。

lines.en: Any ideas for the weekend? Grandma is visiting.
lines.zh: 周末有什么想法？奶奶要来。

lines.en: How about the science museum on Saturday morning?
lines.zh: 周六上午去科技馆怎么样？

lines.en: Sounds good. I can book tickets online tonight.
lines.zh: 听起来不错。我今晚可以网上订票。

lines.en: I will cook lunch on Sunday if you handle the dishes.
lines.zh: 周日我来做午饭，你洗碗怎么样？

lines.en: Deal. Should we invite Uncle Chen too?
lines.zh: 成交。要请陈叔叔吗？

lines.en: Yes, if he is free. We have enough chairs.
lines.zh: 好啊，他有空的话。椅子够坐。
lines.tip: if he is free 有空的话。

lines.en: Then I will message him after work.
lines.zh: 那我下班后发消息给他。

scenarios.title: 学校：课堂与作业
scenarios.description: 请假、交作业、问老师问题。

lines.en: Please hand in your exercise books before the bell.
lines.zh: 请在铃响前交上练习册。

lines.en: Sorry, I left mine at home. May I bring it tomorrow?
lines.zh: 抱歉，我落在家里了。明天带来可以吗？
lines.tip: leave something at home 落在家里。

lines.en: All right, but do not forget next time. Any questions?
lines.zh: 好吧，下次别忘。有问题吗？
lines.tip: All right 在此表示勉强同意。

lines.en: Yes. Could you explain the third question again?
lines.zh: 有。第三题能再讲一遍吗？

lines.en: Of course. Look at the example on page twelve.
lines.zh: 当然。看第十二页的例子。
lines.tip: page twelve 序数可说 the twelfth page。

lines.en: I see now. Thank you, teacher.
lines.zh: 我明白了。谢谢老师。

scenarios.title: 学校：社团与小组合作
scenarios.description: 报名社团、讨论分工、约自习。

lines.en: We are recruiting new members for the drama club this week.
lines.zh: 本周话剧社在招新。

lines.en: I am interested. What do I need to prepare for the audition?
lines.zh: 我有兴趣。试镜要准备什么？

lines.en: A short monologue, about one minute. No costumes needed.
lines.zh: 一段约一分钟的独白。不需要服装。

lines.en: Got it. Can we rehearse together after class?
lines.zh: 明白了。下课能一起排练吗？

lines.en: Sure. Let us meet in Room 204 at four thirty.
lines.zh: 可以。四点半在 204 见。
lines.tip: Let us = Let's 的完整形。

lines.en: I will bring the script and print two copies.
lines.zh: 我带剧本并打印两份。
